text: For District 2 Member of the California State Board of Equalization, the recorded comparison for Sally J. Lieber includes CAIR Action's general-election endorsement and Vote for Peace's Ally-tier support, alongside endorsements from Muslim Dems and Friends of Alameda County and Congressman Ro Khanna. A 2024 CAIR Action guide further describes her, then a county-supervisor candidate, as an outspoken supporter of ceasefire and Palestinian rights. Substantive contrary evidence includes her stated support for implementing AB 715 and SB 48 and strong opposition to weakening them, as well as a questionnaire response in which she calls Israel a safe haven and the United States' one true ally in the region. On the Israel-aligned side, the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated mission includes supporting Israel as a secure Jewish state, endorsed her for both the primary and the general election.
